name: cc-enhanced
description: Tool-routing guidance, batch edits, ranged views, plan and memory diffs, configured agent model routing, and a configurable status line for stock Claude Code.

statusline.title: Status line
statusline.description: auto draws the cc-enhanced status line only when no statusLine command is configured; replace draws it in place of that command's output; off leaves the footer stock.

statusline_path_link.title: Status line: path link
statusline_path_link.description: Make the path a file link. Turn off in terminals without hyperlink support, which print the link's URL beside it.

statusline_effort.title: Status line: effort
statusline_effort.description: Show this model's effort: /effort <level> updates it at once, otherwise each main-conversation request's level does.

statusline_cost.title: Status line: session cost
statusline_cost.description: Show what this session has cost.

statusline_five_hour.title: Status line: 5-hour usage
statusline_five_hour.description: Show the 5-hour usage window and its reset.

statusline_weekly.title: Status line: weekly usage
statusline_weekly.description: Show the 7-day usage window and its reset.

statusline_model_limits.title: Status line: per-model weekly limits
statusline_model_limits.description: Fetch and show per-model weekly limits from your Claude account, at most every five minutes across sessions.

statusline_cache.title: Status line: prompt cache
statusline_cache.description: Show the live prompt-cache lifetime and the last response's cache reads and writes.

statusline_context.title: Status line: context
statusline_context.description: Show context-window tokens and percent used.

statusline_agents.title: Agent rows
statusline_agents.description: Draw each subagent and teammate row in the agent list as name, model, effort, context, burn rate, elapsed time, and current task.
